clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Shoni gathers parts from the roaming machines of Gnomeregan. She needs them to repair tunneling vehicles meant to help reclaim the city in Dun Morogh.

After High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the surviving gnomes fled Gnomeregan, thousands of automated mechanisms, clockwork sentries, and industrial robots remained inside. The machines still roam the radioactive city's corridors on their own. In Stormwind City, tinker Shoni is assembling gyrodrillmatic excavationators to break through Gnomeregan's defenses and reclaim the lost city. Without fresh materials, she sends adventurers into the contaminated halls to salvage working parts from the robots, including springs, wires, and gyro-components.
